economy.summary: Says the economy works for the wealthy and corporations at the expense of working people; supports livable wages and affordable housing investments, and opposes corporate tax breaks.
economy.short: Supports livable wages, affordable housing; opposes corporate tax breaks.

taxes.summary: Cosponsors the For the 99.5 Percent Act to tax the largest estates, and opposes tax breaks for corporations and members of Congress trading stocks.
taxes.short: Cosponsors wealth-tax bill; opposes corporate tax breaks, congressional stock trading.

abortion.summary: Supports federal legislation to codify abortion rights nationwide and repeal of the Hyde Amendment; opposes abortion bans and prioritizes reducing Black maternal mortality.
abortion.short: Supports federal abortion protections, Hyde repeal; opposes abortion bans.

education.summary: Supports equitable public school funding regardless of zip code, universal free school meals, tuition-free public college, and canceling student loan debt; opposes book bans.
education.short: Supports school funding, free college, debt cancellation; opposes book bans.

healthcare.summary: Supports Medicare for All covering vision, dental, reproductive, mental health, and long-term care, and eliminating copays, deductibles, and premiums.
healthcare.short: Supports Medicare for All; supports eliminating copays, deductibles, premiums.

energy.summary: Supports a Green New Deal and a transition to 100% clean and renewable energy; opposes fracking and cites securing $143 million for Pittsburgh-Harrisburg passenger rail.
energy.short: Supports Green New Deal, clean-energy transition; opposes fracking.

guns.summary: Supports an assault weapons ban and expanded background checks, and supports community violence intervention programs; opposes cash bail and mandatory minimum sentencing.
guns.short: Supports assault weapons ban, expanded background checks, violence intervention.

economy.summary: Says overregulation has crushed local businesses and sent jobs elsewhere; supports policies that support working families, bring back good-paying union jobs, and protect small business owners.
economy.short: Opposes overregulation; supports union jobs and small business owners.

taxes.summary: Proposes reining in wasteful government spending and working to balance the federal budget with accountability in Congress.
taxes.short: Proposes cutting wasteful spending and balancing the federal budget.

abortion.summary: Says the Dobbs decision rightly returned abortion to the states and opposes national abortion legislation on either side, including a national ban; supports exceptions for rape, incest, and the life of the mother.
abortion.short: Says states decide abortion; opposes national legislation; supports exceptions.

education.summary: Supports expanding school choice so families can find the best fit for their children, giving teachers needed tools, and empowering parents in education.
education.short: Supports expanding school choice and empowering parents in education.

healthcare.summary: Supports government-funded health insurance being available for all who want it alongside private healthcare options.
healthcare.short: Supports optional government-funded insurance alongside private healthcare options.

energy.summary: Supports an all-of-the-above energy strategy leveraging Western Pennsylvania's energy resources to create local jobs and reduce dependence on foreign powers; has supported streamlining energy permitting.
energy.short: Supports all-of-the-above energy strategy and streamlined energy permitting.

guns.summary: Says no new restrictions on gun ownership are needed and supports severe penalties for gun crimes; opposes redirecting funds from police departments and supports prosecuting repeat violent offenders.
guns.short: Opposes new gun restrictions; supports severe penalties, police funding.
